name: lifecycle
resume: All 16 exports of lifecycle 1.0.5 are checked. Deprecation and the test helpers call rlang. pkg_lifecycle_statuses reads installed help topics. lifecycle_linter, lint_lifecycle, and lint_tidyverse_lifecycle stop with rlang's missing-package error because lintr is not in the registry. There is no crate.

functions.name: badge
functions.done: The Rd markup for a lifecycle stage.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(lifecycle))
one <- function() {
  badge("deprecated")
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
shown <- gsub("\n", " / ", shown, fixed = TRUE)
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

functions.done: Warn that a function was deprecated. The package is <NA> at the top level.

proof.r:

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(lifecycle))

  gsub("\n", " / ", tryCatch(deprecate_warn("1.0.0", "foo()", "bar()"), warning = function(e) conditionMessage(e)), fixed = TRUE)
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
shown <- gsub("\n", " / ", shown, fixed = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import time
from lifecycle import deprecate_warn

def one():
    import warnings
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        deprecate_warn("1.0.0", "foo()", "bar()")
    if caught:
        one.msg = str(caught[-1].message).replace("\n", " / ")
    return one.msg

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
if isinstance(value, bool):
    shown = "TRUE" if value else "FALSE"
elif value is None:
    shown = "NULL"
else:
    shown = str(value).replace("\n", " / ")
print("VALUE " + shown)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
